thread:
Asha: noticed billing cohort distributions shifted after yesterday's enrich rollout. sampled traces don't match cohort counts.
Ben: do we have an example tenant?
Asha: tenant=smartfin, ingress sample rate 0.5%, post-enrich cohort shows many more small-prompt events in sampled set.
Kai: sounds like sampling decision was taken from trace_id but cohort is computed later. classic mismatch.
Asha: proposal: introduce an ingress sample_key carried through pipeline. enrichment writes mapping sample_key->cohort; billing joins on sample_key.
Ben: agree. quick concerns: header growth, mapping TTL, and missing keys for older traces/backfills.
Kai: TTL should match billing lookback; suggest 14d. for missing keys, mark cohort_approx and add a reconciliation job to rebuild mappings from raw payloads.
Asha: we should also version sample_key and document fallback behavior. I'll draft an RFC with rollout steps, perf estimates, and error metrics to watch (conflicts, missing_keys).
infra-bot: created ticket INF-21001: "ingress-sample_key mapping + reconciliation RFC" -> https://go/internal/INF-21001
Ben: assigning to Kai + Asha for RFC. will run a short entropy test on token derivation options.
